items.title: FinWise Exits Card Receivables, Acquires Tallied Platform
items.why: A bank-partner lender stepping back from card receivables may open capacity for new card program partners.
items.summary_ai: FinWise is exiting its card receivables business and acquiring the Tallied platform.
